name: sobremesa
description: Sobremesa: juegos de mesa multijugador en games.samuelciocan.com

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @games/game-logic build && pnpm --filter games-server build && pnpm --filter games-client build
scripts.format: prettier --ignore-path .gitignore --write apps packages tests deploy playwright.config.ts README.md docs package.json docker-compose.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --ignore-path .gitignore --check apps packages tests deploy playwright.config.ts README.md docs package.json docker-compose.yml
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:i18n && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
